# Sovereign Factory

**AI Enterprise OS — Star Trek crew agents in your editor.**

This extension provides a direct bridge to the Sovereign Factory engine, allowing you to run missions, perform sensor sweeps, and coordinate with the Star Trek crew directly from VS Code.

## Features
- **Agent Viewport**: Real-time streaming of agent cognition.
- **Mission Control**: Dispatch complex tasks to specialized personas.
- **Bridge Diagnostics**: Monitor the health of your local MCP bridge.
